segments.text: Seeing that the office and dewtie of the godlie Magistrat is nocht onlie to purge the Churche of God from all superstitioun, and to set it at libertie from bondage of tyrranis; but also to provide, to the uttermost of his power, how it may abide in the same puritie to the posteriteis following; we can not but frelie communicat our judgementis with your Honouris in this behalf.
